purpose: Map existing frozen specification fixes to initial findings. This document does not apply edits or assert runtime implementation.

coverage.selection: Initial file/requirements or problem text names M4/M5 or their task/review/verify/retry/race interfaces, plus shared partial-receipt, predicate, schema, glyph, and Council-scope findings.

runtimeEvidence: None. Catalog tests are planned. Follow-up independent audits are pending.

findings.resolution: Separate PelRevisionDecisionV1 and PelRevisionMappingV1 validate an unchanged whole-top-level prefix. Revised source starts a new evaluator. Persisted aliases supply old receipts under new request IDs while retaining original effect IDs and reservations. Partial-form edits and changed completed arguments fail before dispatch.
M3 defines closed ProviderControlsV1. M5 resolves controls from immutable role/profile defaults, records them in the binding, and fixes review toolChoice to none.

M4 persists tool intent/result records keyed by effect, full provider identity, and call ID, plus durable cursors and protected checkpoint artifacts. Repeated calls resend host-resolved bounded content without another tool execution. Changed arguments under one key fail.

The shared transport now observes existing identities and returns pending/completed/cancelled/not-found/unsupported. M4 records observed results without redispatch. Not-found and unsupported do not establish no dispatch. M5 uses destination observation after lost publication acknowledgement.

Read-only preparation chooses reuse, needs-action, or a prepared external operation before reservation. Reuse and absent grants reserve zero actions. M4 reserves exactly one action for dispatch and supplies a token. Handlers cannot reserve again.

Each host result has an exact ordered association schema with unique keys and nested prior evidence. Verification includes Boolean passed and current status. Duplicate/additional keys fail instead of shadowing newer results.

The design includes exact self-recursive Pel source carrying current result, round, and maximum. Approval stops immediately. Exhaustion/no-change returns explicit delivery-needs-action data and exit 3 before another effect. Tests assert two tasks for one successful correction and N+1 for exhaustion.

The host resolves argument-dependent canonical resources against M2 envelopes. Race allocates separate admitted worktree grants before dispatch and passes them through child context. Ordinary parallel tasks sharing a workspace serialize.

A valid host failure produces PelStep.failed with PEL_HOST_FAILURE and preserved structured cause. Retry classifies child failures before merge. Unretryable failure stops new dispatch and cancels siblings. M4 defines exact state/exit mappings.

One M3 ProviderFailure union is retained verbatim in cause.providerFailure. Only RateLimited and safely reconcilable TransportDisconnected can retry, through :rate-limited and :transport-disconnected. Exhaustive switches and per-tag tests replace competing category vocabularies.

One-based parent/retry/attempt and parent/race/contender child IDs enter nested request paths. M1 exports closure-environment extraction. Counter accounting includes failed and abandoned children exactly once, preventing both identity collisions and lost loser costs.

A finite admitted cancellation observation window cannot reset on repeated requests. Unsupported/unknown remote outcomes become needs-action exit 3 after local cleanup and window expiry. Local-only effects require only confirmed local cleanup.

Run admission stores exact immutable source, full authoring snapshot, registry, and project settings by hashed artifact reference. Resume ignores changed working files and installed defaults. Missing or mismatched stored bytes fail binding-mismatch before dispatch.

findings.resolution: Product admission requires live-qualified evidence for every required exact profile/transport capability. Only an injected test-only Layer admits fixture evidence, labels it test-fixture, and cannot produce live-qualified evidence or product authority.

Role selectors resolve through hashed roleBindings to exact profile, transport, controls, and credential reference. Optional transport must match admission and ambiguity fails. Initial coding tasks require qualified native transports, while review requires enforceable toolPolicy none.

The release dependency table and catalogs use milestone IDs. M2 owns provider bootstrap and M3 extends it. M4/M5 retain their explicit M1-M3/M1-M4 dependency lists and do not create provider bootstrap files.

CLI outcome classes are consistently 0 success, 1 failed, 2 invalid, 3 needs-action, 4 cancelled, and 5 pending. Missing source/configuration, checker rejection, unsupported profile admission, and invalid binding return 2 before dispatch.

Suspension lists all unreceipted requests with alreadyEmitted flags in deterministic invocation order. Partial receipt delivery preserves pending requests. M4 joins repeated requests to durable effects rather than redispatching them.
